title: feat(hugk1): corridor-slide keeps k=1 reverse: t=3 vs t=5
science: Regression check on the new mu rule from #6791: adding the corridor-slide clause does NOT break the small-scale bar -- on B_6(0), t(1,0,0)=3, t(1,1,1)=5, so 27 > 25 and same-k reverse still holds at k=1. Shows the clause is live on this ball anyway (t(6,0,0)=18 under mu vs 14 under nu) and separates mu from the rival lambda patch, which prices the body 1->2 hop and would spoil k=1. So mu is the first rule in the slice holding same-k reverse at BOTH k=1 and k=7.
verdict_pair: same-k reverse k=1 = YES under mu (27>25)
